summary.text: Nick Coffey is the Democratic nominee. A fifth-generation Oklahoman and graduate of the University of Oklahoma College of Law, he is a federal prosecutor (described by Oklahoma Voice as a former one) in the Western District of Oklahoma who has handled drug-trafficking, money-laundering and firearms cases. His priorities are rooting out public corruption, public safety, protecting children and watching taxpayer spending.

paragraphs.text: Federal prosecutor for the Western District of Oklahoma; served on the Department of Justice's Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Force.
Named Prosecutor of the Year by the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Western District of Oklahoma in 2024, and by Homeland Security Investigations in 2023, according to his campaign.
Graduate of the University of Oklahoma College of Law.
